description: List the comments on a document (`doc_id`). A reply's `parent_num` is the `num` of its thread's first comment; the ones you wrote carry `you: true`. To add one use `comments_add`.

workspace_id.description: The workspace to act in: a `workspace_id` from `workspaces` action:list, which also says which node it is on.

name: comments
title: Comments
